verdict.rationale: Metorial's organizations-and-projects docs say each environment has its own provider deployments, API keys, auth configs, and logs, "so changes in a sandbox do not affect production." That directly delivers the story's core, and version pinning for production deployments supports keeping the two apart. missing for 10: in-depth docs on creating and promoting sandbox environments, any detail on test or mock data handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration that isolation works as claimed.
